items.name: Start Planning Session
items.summary: A GoA business analyst or developer initiates a new planning session by providing an initial title and optional description of the business problem they want to explore.
preconditions: User is authenticated via Keycloak JWT with planner-user role
User is associated with an active ADSP tenant
items.trigger: User navigates to the Planner section in TMW and selects 'New Planning Session'

mainFlow.action: Selects 'New Planning Session' from the planner dashboard
mainFlow.systemResponse: System displays a new session creation form

mainFlow.action: Enters a session title (required) and optional initial description of the business problem
mainFlow.systemResponse: System validates the title length (1-200 characters)

mainFlow.action: Creates a PlanningSession document in MongoDB with status 'active', tenantId, userId, title, and timestamps
mainFlow.systemResponse: Session is persisted with a generated UUID

mainFlow.action: Creates an empty BusinessModel document linked to the session and publishes a session-created domain event
mainFlow.systemResponse: BusinessModel and domain event are persisted

mainFlow.action: Generates a welcome message introducing the planning process and prompts for the user's business problem
mainFlow.systemResponse: Agent response is stored as a ConversationMessage and streamed to the UI

mainFlow.action: Reads the welcome message and begins describing their business problem
mainFlow.systemResponse: User is in active conversation state

alternateFlows.name: Active session already exists for this user

steps.action: Detects that the user has an existing active or paused session
steps.systemResponse: System displays a prompt asking whether to continue the existing session or start a new one

steps.action: Chooses to start a new session despite the existing one
steps.systemResponse: System proceeds with new session creation

steps.action: MongoDB write fails due to connectivity or validation error
steps.systemResponse: System returns HTTP 503 with a user-visible error message and logs the failure

postconditions: A new PlanningSession exists in MongoDB with status 'active'
A linked BusinessModel document exists with version 1
A session-created domain event has been published to RabbitMQ
The user is in the active planning workspace
items.frequencyOfUse: On-demand, typically once per new business problem or feature

items.name: Describe Business Problem and Build Model
items.summary: A user engages in a multi-turn conversation with the Planning Agent to describe their business problem. The agent asks clarifying questions, infers business concepts, and incrementally updates the structured business model.
preconditions: An active PlanningSession exists for the user
The user is authenticated with planner-user role or higher
items.trigger: User types a message in the planning chat interface and submits it

mainFlow.action: Types a message describing their business problem or answering a clarifying question and submits
mainFlow.systemResponse: System validates the message content (max 10000 characters)

mainFlow.action: Persists the user ConversationMessage to MongoDB and assembles the LLM context from session history and current BusinessModel
mainFlow.systemResponse: Context assembled within 500ms

mainFlow.action: Calls the Anthropic Claude API with the assembled context via the LLMCallWrapper
mainFlow.systemResponse: Streaming response begins within 5 seconds

mainFlow.action: Streams response to the user including business concept inferences and follow-up questions
mainFlow.systemResponse: UI displays streaming text with typing indicator

mainFlow.action: Parses the agent response to extract newly identified business concepts and updates the BusinessModel document atomically
mainFlow.systemResponse: BusinessModel version incremented and persisted

mainFlow.action: Runs PatternMatchingService against the updated model; if a match exceeds the threshold, surfaced to the agent context for next turn
mainFlow.systemResponse: Pattern match status updated in session state

steps.action: Pattern match confidence reaches or exceeds 60; the matched pattern is noted in the session state
steps.systemResponse: Pattern match stored in BusinessModel.matchedPatternId

steps.action: In the next turn, uses the matched pattern's clarifying questions and service mappings to focus conversation
steps.systemResponse: Pattern-specific guidance applied to conversation

alternateFlows.name: Business model confidence reaches 70 — hypothesis triggered

steps.action: BusinessModel confidenceScore reaches or exceeds 70 after model update
steps.systemResponse: HypothesisGenerationService is triggered asynchronously

steps.action: HypothesisGenerationService generates and persists a SolutionHypothesis with status 'proposed'
steps.systemResponse: Hypothesis appears in the UI HypothesisPanel

steps.action: LLMCallWrapper exhausts retries or circuit breaker is open
steps.systemResponse: System returns HTTP 503 with a user-visible message that the AI service is temporarily unavailable. The user message is preserved in the session for retry.

postconditions: User message and agent response are persisted as ConversationMessages
BusinessModel is updated with any newly identified concepts
Pattern matching has been re-evaluated
If confidenceScore >= 70, a SolutionHypothesis has been generated
items.frequencyOfUse: Multiple times per session, potentially dozens of turns

items.name: Review and Correct Business Model
items.summary: A user reviews the structured business model the Planning Agent has constructed from their conversation, identifies any misclassified concepts, and corrects them through the UI.
preconditions: An active PlanningSession exists with at least one concept in the BusinessModel
User is authenticated with planner-user role or higher
items.trigger: User selects 'View Business Model' from the planning session workspace

mainFlow.action: Opens the Business Model view within the active session
mainFlow.systemResponse: System displays the BusinessModelViewer component with all concepts listed by type

mainFlow.action: Reviews the list of classified concepts and their types
mainFlow.systemResponse: Concepts are displayed with type badges and source text excerpts

mainFlow.action: Selects a misclassified concept and changes its type using the type selector dropdown
mainFlow.systemResponse: System validates the new type is a valid enum value

mainFlow.action: Updates the BusinessConcept conceptType in MongoDB and increments the BusinessModel version
mainFlow.systemResponse: Model view refreshes with corrected concept type

steps.action: Continues correcting additional misclassified concepts one by one
steps.systemResponse: Each correction is persisted immediately

steps.action: BusinessModel version has changed since the user loaded the view (concurrent agent update)
steps.systemResponse: System returns HTTP 409 and prompts the user to refresh the model view

postconditions: BusinessConcept types reflect user corrections
BusinessModel version has been incremented for each correction
PatternMatchingService will re-evaluate on next agent turn
items.frequencyOfUse: One to several times per session

items.name: Review and Accept Solution Hypothesis
items.summary: A user reviews one or more solution hypotheses generated by the Planning Agent, understands the reasoning, and either accepts a hypothesis or requests a revised one.
preconditions: At least one SolutionHypothesis exists with status 'proposed'
User is authenticated with planner-user role or higher
items.trigger: A SolutionHypothesis is generated and the HypothesisPanel displays in the workspace

mainFlow.action: Views the HypothesisPanel displaying the proposed solution hypothesis
mainFlow.systemResponse: System displays the plain-language summary, ADSP service list, and reasoning (initially collapsed)

mainFlow.action: Expands the reasoning section to understand why the services were recommended
mainFlow.systemResponse: Full reasoning explanation and implementation order are displayed

mainFlow.action: Selects 'Accept Hypothesis' to confirm the proposed solution direction
mainFlow.systemResponse: System updates the SolutionHypothesis status from 'proposed' to 'accepted' in MongoDB

mainFlow.action: Publishes a hypothesis-generated domain event with the accepted hypothesis details
mainFlow.systemResponse: Domain event persisted to RabbitMQ

mainFlow.action: Updates the session status to reflect an accepted hypothesis and surfaces recommended next steps
mainFlow.systemResponse: Session workspace shows specialist navigation options

steps.action: Selects 'Request Revision' and provides feedback on what should change
steps.systemResponse: Feedback is sent to the Planning Agent as a new conversation message

steps.action: Original hypothesis status is set to 'superseded'. HypothesisGenerationService is triggered again with feedback context
steps.systemResponse: A new SolutionHypothesis is generated and displayed

steps.action: Anthropic API unavailable during revision generation
steps.systemResponse: System notifies user the revision is pending and will complete when the service recovers. Feedback is preserved.

postconditions: SolutionHypothesis status is 'accepted' or 'superseded'
Domain event published
Session shows recommended next steps based on accepted hypothesis
items.frequencyOfUse: Once to several times per completed session

items.name: Consult Specialist Agent
items.summary: A GoA developer navigates to a specialist agent workspace for an ADSP service (form-service, pdf-service, comment-service, or notification-service) to receive deep technical guidance on the selected service within the context of their planning session.
preconditions: A SolutionHypothesis with status 'proposed' or 'accepted' exists referencing the target service
User is authenticated with planner-user role or higher
The specialist agent for the target service is enabled in the tenant configuration
items.trigger: User selects a specialist service from the SpecialistNavigator component within the planning session

mainFlow.action: Selects the form-service specialist from the SpecialistNavigator
mainFlow.systemResponse: System loads the specialist workspace with the relevant session context pre-injected

mainFlow.action: Calls SpecialistAgentService to initialize the specialist agent with session business model and hypothesis context
mainFlow.systemResponse: Specialist agent context assembled within 2 seconds

mainFlow.action: Asks a service-specific technical question in the specialist chat
mainFlow.systemResponse: Specialist agent receives the question with context

mainFlow.action: Provides deep service-specific guidance on form configuration, integration patterns, and implementation steps
mainFlow.systemResponse: Streaming response displayed in the specialist workspace

mainFlow.action: Updates the session specialistProgress map to mark the target service as 'in-progress'
mainFlow.systemResponse: Progress persisted to MongoDB

alternateFlows.name: Specialist initiated by Planning Agent delegation

steps.action: Identifies a service-specific question requiring specialist depth and delegates automatically
steps.systemResponse: SpecialistAgentService invoked with delegation context

steps.action: Returns a response that the Planning Agent integrates into the main session context
steps.systemResponse: Delegation response stored in specialistProgress

steps.action: SpecialistAgentService call times out or returns error after 60 seconds
steps.systemResponse: System displays an error message that the specialist is temporarily unavailable. The specialistProgress entry is marked as 'not-started' and the user is returned to the planning session.

postconditions: Specialist workspace is loaded with session context
specialistProgress updated for the target service
User can navigate back to the planning session without losing context
items.frequencyOfUse: One to several times per session for technical guidance

items.name: Resume Interrupted Planning Session
items.summary: A user who previously started a planning session returns to it after a break (hours, days, or weeks) and continues from exactly where they left off with full context restored.
preconditions: A PlanningSession exists with status 'active' or 'paused' for the authenticated user
User is authenticated with planner-user role or higher
items.trigger: User selects an existing session from the session list and clicks 'Resume'

mainFlow.action: Selects a paused or active session from the session list and clicks Resume
mainFlow.systemResponse: System begins loading session state

mainFlow.action: Fetches the PlanningSession, BusinessModel, SolutionHypotheses, and last 50 ConversationMessages from MongoDB
mainFlow.systemResponse: All state loaded within 3 seconds

mainFlow.action: Updates the session lastResumedAt timestamp and status to 'active' if it was 'paused'
mainFlow.systemResponse: Session state updated in MongoDB

mainFlow.action: Renders the planning workspace with restored conversation history, current business model, and hypothesis status
mainFlow.systemResponse: Workspace displayed with full context

mainFlow.action: Generates a brief context summary acknowledging prior conversation and suggesting next steps based on current session state
mainFlow.systemResponse: Welcome-back message streamed to the UI

alternateFlows.name: Session has been idle for more than 7 days

steps.action: Detects session has been idle more than 7 days and prompts the Planning Agent to provide a more detailed context recap
steps.systemResponse: Extended context summary generated covering all prior decisions and open questions

exceptionFlows.name: Session not found or not owned by user

steps.action: Session does not exist or does not belong to the authenticated user tenant+userId
steps.systemResponse: System returns HTTP 404 and displays an error message. User is returned to the session list.

postconditions: Session status is 'active'
lastResumedAt timestamp updated
User is in the active planning workspace with full prior context
items.frequencyOfUse: Common — multi-day planning is the norm for complex GoA projects

items.name: Manage Business Pattern Library
items.summary: An ADSP tenant administrator creates, edits, or deactivates business pattern templates to customize the pattern library available for planning sessions in their tenant.
preconditions: User is authenticated with planner-admin or tenant-admin role
ADSP Configuration Service is available
items.trigger: Administrator navigates to the Pattern Library management section in TMW

mainFlow.action: Views the list of active business patterns for the tenant
mainFlow.systemResponse: System displays a paginated list of BusinessPattern records fetched from the Configuration Service

mainFlow.action: Selects 'Create New Pattern' and fills in the required pattern fields
mainFlow.systemResponse: Form is displayed with all BusinessPattern fields and validation rules

mainFlow.action: Submits the new pattern form
mainFlow.systemResponse: System validates all required fields and field constraints

mainFlow.action: Creates the BusinessPattern record via the Configuration Service adapter and invalidates the local cache
mainFlow.systemResponse: Pattern persisted with a generated patternId and isActive=true

mainFlow.action: Writes an audit log entry for the pattern creation action
mainFlow.systemResponse: Audit record persisted with actor, action, patternId, and timestamp

steps.action: Selects an existing pattern and edits its fields
steps.systemResponse: Form pre-populated with existing pattern data

steps.action: Saves the edited pattern
steps.systemResponse: Pattern updated in Configuration Service; audit log entry written for update action

steps.action: Selects an active pattern and clicks Deactivate
steps.systemResponse: Confirmation dialog displayed

steps.action: Confirms deactivation
steps.systemResponse: Pattern isActive set to false; audit log entry written for deactivation action; cache invalidated

steps.action: Required fields are missing or exceed maximum lengths
steps.systemResponse: HTTP 400 returned with field-level errors array; user prompted to correct the form

steps.action: Configuration Service call fails or times out
steps.systemResponse: HTTP 503 returned; user informed that pattern management is temporarily unavailable. No partial state is written.

postconditions: BusinessPattern record is created, updated, or deactivated in Configuration Service
Local pattern cache is invalidated
Audit log entry records the administrative action
items.frequencyOfUse: Infrequent — when new patterns are needed or existing ones need updating

items.name: Export Session Plan
items.summary: A user exports the complete planning session state as a portable JSON file for sharing with stakeholders or storing externally.
preconditions: An active, paused, or completed PlanningSession exists for the user
User is authenticated with planner-user role or higher
items.trigger: User clicks the Export button on the session detail view

mainFlow.action: Clicks the Export button on the session detail view
mainFlow.systemResponse: System initiates session export

mainFlow.action: Fetches PlanningSession, BusinessModel, SolutionHypotheses, and ConversationMessages from MongoDB
mainFlow.systemResponse: Export data assembled within 2 seconds

mainFlow.action: Serializes the export payload to JSON conforming to the data_io_schema and initiates a file download
mainFlow.systemResponse: Browser triggers download of a JSON file named {title}-{date}.json

mainFlow.action: Displays a success confirmation toast
mainFlow.systemResponse: User sees confirmation that the export has been downloaded

steps.action: MongoDB read fails
steps.systemResponse: HTTP 503 returned with user-visible error. No partial export is produced.

postconditions: A valid JSON export file has been downloaded by the user
The session state in the database is unchanged by the export operation
items.frequencyOfUse: End of planning engagement, typically once per completed session

items.name: Authenticate and Access Planner
items.summary: A GoA user authenticates via Keycloak SSO through the Tenant Management Webapp and accesses the planner-service with the appropriate Keycloak JWT token containing their tenant and role claims.
preconditions: User has a valid GoA Keycloak account
User has been assigned the planner-user, planner-admin, or tenant-admin role in Keycloak
items.trigger: User navigates to the TMW Planner section

mainFlow.action: Navigates to the TMW application
mainFlow.systemResponse: If not authenticated, TMW redirects to Keycloak login

mainFlow.action: Authenticates via Keycloak (existing SSO session or new login)
mainFlow.systemResponse: Keycloak issues a JWT bearer token containing tenantId, userId, and role claims

mainFlow.action: Navigates to the Planner section within TMW
mainFlow.systemResponse: React app sends the JWT in the Authorization header to the planner-service API

mainFlow.action: Passport-jwt middleware validates the token and extracts tenantId and userId claims
mainFlow.systemResponse: Request proceeds with authenticated user context

mainFlow.action: RBAC middleware checks that the user has at least the planner-user role
mainFlow.systemResponse: If role present, access is granted; if not, HTTP 403 is returned with an explanation message

steps.action: JWT validation fails due to expiry, invalid signature, or missing claims
steps.systemResponse: HTTP 401 returned; TMW redirects to Keycloak login

steps.action: User is authenticated but has no planner-user, planner-admin, or tenant-admin role
steps.systemResponse: HTTP 403 returned; UI displays a message explaining access is not authorized and directing the user to their administrator

postconditions: User is authenticated and their tenantId and userId are available for all subsequent operations
RBAC is enforced on all API requests

items.name: View Session History and Audit Log
items.summary: An ADSP tenant administrator reviews the planning session history for their tenant and views the administrative audit log to check for unauthorized or anomalous actions.
preconditions: User is authenticated with planner-admin or tenant-admin role
items.trigger: Administrator navigates to the Session History or Audit Log section in TMW

mainFlow.action: Navigates to the Session History section for the tenant
mainFlow.systemResponse: System displays a paginated list of all sessions for the tenant (not filtered to the admin's own sessions)

mainFlow.action: Filters the list by date range, status, or user
mainFlow.systemResponse: System applies filters and returns the matching sessions

mainFlow.action: Navigates to the Audit Log section
mainFlow.systemResponse: System displays a paginated, read-only view of the audit_events collection for the tenant

mainFlow.action: Reviews audit entries filtering by action type or actor
mainFlow.systemResponse: System returns filtered audit entries in descending timestamp order

steps.action: Request received with planner-user role JWT
steps.systemResponse: HTTP 403 returned; audit log and all-tenant session history are accessible only to planner-admin and tenant-admin roles

postconditions: Administrator has reviewed session and audit data without modifying any records
Audit log read access is itself logged
items.frequencyOfUse: Periodically for compliance review or incident investigation
